apps.name: Apollo
apps.localizedDescription: iOS tweak for Apollo Reddit app - use your own API keys, unlocked Ultra features, and other enhancements

versions.localizedDescription:
### Performance

- Send fewer Reddit requests on **API-Key-Free** accounts by not repeating link preview lookups for sites that block previews and by briefly reusing the Inbox's reply lookups, so ordinary reading reaches Reddit's rate limit later (#1579: @icpryde)
  - New replies, and anything you post or edit, still refresh right away

### Fixes

- Fix **multi-photo posts** showing a reddit.com link and 0 photos since Reddit began marking their photos as failed, so the gallery, feed carousel, media viewer, Save All and Gallery View show them again (#1589: @icpryde)
  - Covers galleries posted from Apollo with Reddit as the Media Upload Host and from other apps; they show as square cards in the feed
- Fix **API-Key-Free search** showing "Error searching" or "Error loading subreddits" for post search, searching within a subreddit or multireddit, and subreddit search (#1557: @DeltAndy123)
- Fix **All Posts (r/all)** showing "Couldn't load posts" on **API-Key-Free** accounts, for every sort and with Exclude Subscriptions (#1570: @icpryde)
  - All Posts has another way in before Old Reddit, and if Reddit blocks another **API-Key-Free** read, a route update can work around it without an app update (#1594: @DeltAndy123)
- Open the feed you chose to start on again at launch by turning **Restore Reading Session** off by default; it moves to Posts & Feeds → Feed (#1511: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - A choice you changed yourself in 4.0.0 is kept, so turn it back on there if you relied on the 4.0.0 default
- Fix a crash when opening a **post or comment link** while Reddit is rate-limiting requests, most often right after returning to Apollo; the usual "Error loading comments" banner shows instead (#1572: @icpryde)
- Fix the **home screen icon** turning into iOS's generic grid after installing or updating Apollo with an alternate icon selected (#1554: @icpryde)
  - Apollo re-applies your icon once on the first launch after the update, so iOS shows its "You have changed the icon" alert; tapping the selected icon again under App Icon also redraws it
- Open a tapped **Inbox reply** or comment link directly on that comment, without the post flashing, gliding and snapping into place, and keep your place when returning from a pushed page (#1584: @icpryde)
- Show the **Unrecoverable** label on deleted comments the archive can't restore, instead of a thin, cut-off red strip with only the age showing (#1578: @icpryde)
- Load **Live Interactive Posts** for accounts set to old Reddit, instead of spinning on "Loading interactive post…", and make the ✕ and ••• buttons work in an interactive post's expanded view (#1553: @icpryde)
  - Report from the ••• menu opens and closes properly, and feed cards return to their compact size after closing
- Keep **sign-in**, **Badge Book** trophies and **API-Key-Free** backup reads working for accounts Old Reddit turns away (#1553: @icpryde)
  - The API-Key-Free sign-in sheet no longer offers Switch to Old Reddit
- Open a just-posted **video post** with its video playing from the "Posted! Tap to view." banner, instead of a still image (#1413: @icpryde)
  - The banner now waits until Reddit finishes processing the video, so it can appear a few seconds later; applies to videos uploaded with **Media Upload Host** set to Reddit
- Stop the **media post composer** jumping when you pick a flair or photo with a title that wraps onto two or more lines (#1571: @icpryde)
- Open the **subreddit switcher** with the keyboard down, so your favorites stay visible until you tap the search field (#1564: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Stop the rows Apollo Reborn adds to the classic (non-Liquid Glass) post **••• menu** turning green on subreddits you moderate; they follow your theme again, and **Remove from Recently Read** is red (#1566: @IllIIllIllIllII)…

apps.name: Lume
apps.localizedDescription: A modern, native IPTV player for Apple platforms.  Browse, search, and stream your Xtream Codes or M3U/M3U8 playlists with a clean SwiftUI interface — Live TV, Movies, and Series, enriched with metadata, EPG, and watch progress that follows you across your devices.

versions.localizedDescription:
### ✨ New Features
- **Lume Cloud**: an optional, end-to-end encrypted sync service alongside iCloud. It keeps profiles, watch progress, favorites and playlists in sync, including with Lume for Android
- Choose how to sync your library on first launch: iCloud, Lume Cloud or Don't Sync
- Sync Now button in Settings › Sync
- Watched badges on posters and episode rows

### ⚡ Improvements
- Switching to Lume Cloud now explains that your other Apple devices follow once they run the latest Lume
- Poster cards stay aligned when a title wraps onto two lines

### 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Skip Intro stays reachable after the player controls appear
- Newly listed episodes show their synced watch state right away
- Fixed favorites, category order and other settings that could go missing or come back after being removed with Lume Cloud
- Lume Cloud now recovers by itself when its sync state goes stale
- Fixed a crash in iCloud sync after a Mac wakes from sleep
- Without Lume Pro, only your first playlist is usable, including playlists synced from other devices

### 🔧 Under the Hood
- Sideload builds now include the Simkl and MDBList integrations
- Updated UI and unit tests, plus localization catalog upkeep

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/bilipp/Lume/compare/v2.8.0...v3.0.0

versions.localizedDescription:
# Version 7.3.0

## New Features
- Updated X to 12.38.1 (this now natively supports the iPhone Duo)
- Added experimental support for the Liquid Glass redesign. Most features have been adapted for it, but a couple aren’t possible to implement (see “Known Issues”)
- Added an option to hide the "Videos for you" timeline module by @vancez in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/159
- Hide the “Game” tab at the top of the timeline when a basketball game is ongoing
- Added an option to reset settings
- Added an option to use a custom color for the tint
- Added a new split-view design for iPad which uses up the entire screen (instead of a stupid blown-up iPhone layout), allowing you to scroll the timeline in the left half and view an individual tweet or profile on the right half. This will not work on iPhone Duos since I do not have one to test this on, so right now it is hardcoded for iPads only.
- Now hides the Money tab on profiles
- Adds an option to hide the Quick Compose button (only on Liquid Glass)
- Added a new method for blocking screenshot detection
- Docs: explain how to open settings, build types and DEB architectures by @migdal-or in https://github.com/NeoFreeBird/app/pull/154

## Fixes
- Made the app icon changer load differently to prevent the app hanging
- Fixed quote tweets not being filtered in the timeline
- Fixed downloading voice messages
- Fixed crashes and general slowdowns with web logins
- Fixed fast block not working
- Fixed the message button on tweets being clickable when hidden
- Fixed certain ads appearing on the timeline
- Fixed the custom font not appearing in a couple places

## Known Issues
- The tweet source label option has been removed (again). X seems hellbent on burning all traces of Twitter (unlike us), so this feature will stay removed unless there’s another endpoint that can be used. Please ping @orionblur on Twitter if you think you’ve found such an endpoint, and we can take it to DMs.
- The “Keep the navigation bar visible” toggle doesn’t work on Liquid Glass, as quite a few app components rely on the tab bar being hidden at times, and in my testing trying to change this caused frequent crashes.

apps.name: Debrify
apps.localizedDescription: Unified debrid management meets Stremio and Trakt — control Real-Debrid, Torbox, and PikPak, sync your watch progress, and browse content  from anywhere. Available on Android, Android TV, Windows, macOS, Linux, and iOS.

versions.localizedDescription:
> ⚠️ **Alpha build** — this release is for **early testers only**. Take a backup before upgrading, expect rough edges, and please report anything broken. Regular users should wait for the upcoming beta.

### ⚽ Sports
- Added a **Sports board** to IPTV, available as a Quick access shelf and on the Spotlight Home Sports shelf.
- Covers **47 leagues** across football, cricket, basketball, American football, hockey, baseball, rugby, tennis, golf, motorsport and combat sports, with day grids and a league picker. Choose leagues under **IPTV settings → Sports & leagues**.
- Matches each fixture to your IPTV channels: guide listings, event streams named for the match (e.g. "CRICKET 03: Bangladesh vs West Indies"), live golf tour coverage, cricket listings by country code (e.g. "RSA v AUS") and listed broadcasters.
- Avoids women's, youth and "A" team streams for men's fixtures, other sports, replays, highlights and streams dated another day.
- Cards show when a channel's coverage starts (e.g. "Eurosport from 13:30"), and live cricket shows the match state such as Stumps or Lunch.

### 📺 IPTV
- Added **Multi-view**: watch several live channels at once in a grid. Add or remove channels from the channel actions (not available on Apple TV).
- When a device can't decode another 4K stream, a multi-view tile switches to another version of the same channel.
- IPTV now keeps the shelf you are on across reloads.

### ⏺️ Recordings
- Added **Recording location & timing**: choose where recordings are saved, and start early or keep recording after the end.
- Added **network share (SMB)** support: copy recordings to a NAS or another computer, or record straight to the share on Android and desktop. Recording continues on the device if the share drops.
- The Recordings page lists and plays recordings on your share. A new share copies recordings made from setup onward, with an option to copy earlier ones.
- Android TV boxes without a system folder picker can now save recordings to a USB drive or SD card.

### 🔎 Sources and addons
- Added **Search sources** (Settings → Engines) to choose which IPTV playlists and media servers title search uses.
- Added **addon auto-update**: Stremio addons refresh in the background when a new version is published. Toggle it from the Addon Hub menu.

### ▶️ Playback
- Added **Mark earlier episodes watched** to the episode options.
- iPhone and iPad: added **Now Playing** controls on the lock screen, Control Centre and AirPods, and a **Swipe to seek** toggle in Playback settings.

### ⚙️ Settings and fixes
- Added a **Storage Usage** page showing what Debrify keeps on disk.
- Spotlight collection folders on phones open on their rows again instead of a single merged shelf.
- Messages with an action button hide on their own again.
- Extensive internal restructuring of Search, Sources, Settings, IPTV, recordings and the player launcher, with added safeguards around profile switching.
- iOS 15 and macOS 12 are now the minimum supported versions.

apps.name: Roam Control
apps.localizedDescription: Choose, test and move an iPhone’s reported location.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights

### 🌍 Roam Control in 10 Languages
Choose English, Hebrew, Arabic, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, French, German or Spanish, or use System Default to select from the supported languages based on your iPhone's language preferences. Switch languages immediately, with right-to-left layout support for Hebrew and Arabic.

### 🗺️ Better Maps and Routes
Refined map controls, route handling and coordinate compatibility, with clearer handling when a route cannot be created.

### 🔄 Smarter Connection Recovery
Improved connection and location-session recovery when the app is allowed to run. iOS may suspend background apps, so unattended recovery cannot be guaranteed.

### 🚶 Your Speed, Your Route
Custom movement speeds for Walking, Cycling and Driving, refined driving targets and travel-time estimates, plus improvements to live walking-speed display.

### ✨ UI Refinements
A clearer language picker with native-language subtitles, improved recovery presentation and better handling of translated text throughout the app.

## What's New

### Localisation
- Eight new languages bring the total to ten, plus System Default.
- Language changes apply immediately without relaunching Roam Control.
- Arabic/Hebrew right-to-left layouts and isolation of PINs, versions and place names.
- Simplified/Traditional Chinese selection respects script and regional language preferences.
- Improved plural forms, multi-argument messages, system permissions text and interface sizing.

### Maps and Movement
- Refined map interaction and coordinate compatibility.
- Improvements to route handling and route-failure feedback.
- Custom Walking, Cycling and Driving movement-speed preferences.
- Better driving speed targets, route time estimates and walking-speed display.

### Connection Health and Recovery
- Improved reconnection and session-recovery behaviour while iOS allows background or foreground execution.
- Refined recovery controls and user guidance.
- Existing LocalDevVPN pairing, diagnostics and Stop & Restore remain available.

## Before You Install
- **iOS 27 or newer** and **Developer Mode** are required.
- **LocalDevVPN is still required** for local pairing connectivity.
- The IPA is **unsigned**. Sign and install it using SideStore or another compatible method.
- For LiveContainer, enable **Fix Local Notifications** before the first launch.

> **Upgrading directly from 0.9.4 or earlier?** Back up favourites, history and supported preferences before migrating to the newer `com.roamcontrol` app identifier. The older app's data will not automatically transfer. Pairing records are not included in backups, so you will need to pair again. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/seanhowarthdev/Roam-Control/blob/main/Documentation/Migration095.md).

## Download and Integrity

**IPA:** `RoamControl-0.9.9-Build105.ipa`

**SHA-256:** `211f1057c70292da468226b39808d8777549c02923c14afc504d9e1d2daba86e`

Read the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/seanhowarthdev/Roam-Control/blob/main/Documentation/Installation.md), [full changelog](https://github.com/seanhowarthdev/Roam-Control/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) and [Responsible Use policy](https://github.com/seanhowarthdev/Roam-Control/blob/main/Documentation/ResponsibleUse.md).

Thanks to everyone who's tested Roam Control and shared feedback. Please report any issues or language improvements through GitHub Issues or our community Discord.

apps.localizedDescription: qBittorrent remote client for iOS devices.
apps.subtitle: qBittorrent remote client for iOS devices.

versions.localizedDescription:
## 📊 Performance & Efficiency

- **Reduced Data Usage:** Network traffic reduced by **93%** thanks to optimized data syncing.
- **Smooth Charts:** Statistics charts now scroll continuously and smoothly instead of updating every two seconds.
- **Responsive Progress Bars:** Progress indicators now feature fluid animations for a more natural feel.

## 🛠️ Interface & Usability

- **Custom Headers:** Specify custom HTTP headers for server connections—offering seamless support for reverse proxies and zero-trust networks (e.g., Cloudflare Access, Authelia).
- **Reworked Server Addition:** Redesigned server setup and edit screens with an updated *Advanced* settings page and deferred saving.
- **Limit Configuration:** Configure precise speed limits, seeding time limits, and share ratios for individual torrents directly in-app.
- **Cleaner Torrent List:** Torrent rows now adapt dynamically to show the most relevant details depending on whether a transfer is downloading, seeding, or paused.
- **Repositioned Add Button:** Moved the "Add Torrent" button to the toolbar for cleaner, more intuitive access.
- **Offline Banner:** A clear overlay banner now appears whenever your connection drops.
- **In-App Logs:** Added a built-in log viewer to review and easily share system events directly inside the app.

## 🐛 Fixes & Refinements

- **Self-Signed Certificate Support:** Full support for untrusted and self-signed SSL certificates, making it easier to connect to home-hosted servers.
- **Stable RSS Downloads:** Fixed an issue in the RSS view where tapping a row to download a torrent caused the confirmation sheet to glitch and reopen unexpectedly.
- **Connection Timeouts:** Implemented strict network timeouts to prevent the app from hanging indefinitely on the launch screen if a server is unresponsive.
- **Clearer Error Alerts:** If adding a `.torrent` file or magnet link fails, a clear error message now pops up explaining what went wrong.

> 同时新增 **AI 助手**、启动时自动检查更新等功能。26.2 与 26.3 都可以正常使用,请悉知.

## 更新内容
* 新增 **AI 助手**:可以和你对话,也能帮你找资源、装模组/整合包/光影,还能读取游戏日志、分析崩溃原因 @herbrine8403
* 新增 **启动时自动检查更新**:有新版本会自动提示,并显示可滚动的更新说明 @yitenchen123
* 适配 **Minecraft 26.3**(SDL3 窗口/输入/呈现层):修复进入游戏黑屏、画面缩在角落、小窗显示错位、Vulkan 下帧率一直显示为 0、物品栏点不动、快捷栏按键错位等问题 @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403
* 修复 **MobileGlues 渲染器在 26.3 下闪退**的深层原因 @yiyeshi0-hash
* 支持 **Metal(metallum)渲染器**,可用于 Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash
* 新增 **MobileGL / MobileGL-gles** 渲染器,并新增 **SimpleFPEWrapper(sfpew)** 以支持 **1.17 及以下**版本(请在设置中开启 sfpew,并在渲染器中选择 **MobileGL-gles**);同时修复 MobileGlues 在 26.3 下的闪退与黑屏 @yitenchen123
* MobileGlues 内置源码升级到上游 2.0.x,着色器转换链不再互相干扰 @yitenchen123
* 引入 **LWJGL 3.3.3 / 3.4.1 两套运行库**看，可按游戏版本自动选择或手动选择 @yitenchen123 @herbrine8403 
* 修复 **Forge / NeoForge 直装**时的启动器被关闭、直装后闪退、模块冲突等问题 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
* 修复 OptiFine 直装、整合包导入,以及下载源和镜像相关的报错 @yitenchen123
* 修复 **JIT** 相关问题:开启 JIT 后启动不再闪退(含使用外部 JIT 后启动闪退的情况),并新增 JIT 工具选择 @herbrine8403 @yiyeshi0-hash
* 优化**内存占用**:自动识别大内存权限,减少后台内存回收导致的闪退 @herbrine8403 @yitenchen123
* 补全简体中文缺失的文本,并同步 Crowdin @herbrine8403
* 改进**构建与打包流程**:双版本运行库、复用已编译组件、构建日志更清晰 @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
* 其他内容请前往 Commit 界面查看

## 注意事项
> [!IMPORTANT]
> 若要在 Minecraft 26.3 上使用 **Vulkan**,请把渲染器选为 **Zink**,同时把渲染 API 改为 **Vulkan**。

## 贡献者
* @yitenchen123

**完整更新日志**: https://github.com/herbrine8403/Amethyst-iOS-MyRemastered/compare/5.0.0...5.1.0

---

# Air 5.1.0

> [!NOTE]
> This update is mainly about **Minecraft 26.3** support and fixes several issues including **JIT startup crashes**;
> it also adds an **AI assistant** and an automatic update check on launch. Both 26.2 and 26.3 work fine.

## Changelog
* Added an **AI assistant**: chat with it, let it find and install mods / modpacks / shaders, and let it read game logs and explain crashes @herbrine8403
* Added an **automatic update check on launch**: you get notified when a new version is out, with scrollable release notes @yitenchen123
* Added **Minecraft 26.3** support (SDL3 window / input / presentation): fixed the black screen on entering a world, the picture stuck in a corner, having to change the resolution once to get a picture, wrong display in small windows, frame rate always showing 0 with Vulkan, resolution switching not working, the on-screen keyboard and control buttons not typing, the inventory not being clickable, and wrong hotbar keys @yitenchen123 @Gsjsjzhznsz @herbrine8403
* Fixed why the **MobileGlues renderer crashed on 26.3**: a render hook mistook itself for the real implementation and kept calling itself until it crashed @yiyeshi0-hash
* Added **Metal (metallum)** renderer support for Minecraft 26.2 / 26.3 @yiyeshi0-hash
* Added the **MobileGL / MobileGL-gles** renderers, and **SimpleFPEWrapper (sfpew)** to support **1.17 and below** (enable sfpew in the settings and pick **MobileGL-gles** as the renderer); also fixed MobileGlues crashes and black screens on 26.3 @yitenchen123
* Upgraded the built-in MobileGlues sources to upstream 2.0.x; the shader conversion chain no longer interferes with itself @yitenchen123
* Added two sets of **LWJGL runtime libraries (3.3.3 / 3.4.1)**, picked automatically by game version @yitenchen123
* Fixed **Forge / NeoForge direct install** issues: launcher being closed during install, crash right after install, and module conflicts @yiyeshi0-hash @yitenchen123
* Fixed OptiFine direct install, modpack import, and download source / mirror errors @yitenchen123
* Fixed **JIT** issues: enabling JIT (including using an external JIT) no longer crashes the launcher on start, plus a new JIT tool option @herbrine8403 @yiyeshi0-hash…

Ferrite v0.7.4 has been released.

Downloading from releases? Get the zip file. The ipa file may not work!

Changelog:

- Fix encoding URLs with POST queries. The app was not percent encoding URLEncoded POST request bodies. Fix this to avoid errors from websites expecting these encoded strings.
- Temporarily disable liquid glass. Liquid glass breaks some parts of Ferrite's UI. Disable it for now and fix this in the future.
- Make TorBox a more prominent debrid option. TorBox is a way better service and API than RealDebrid at this point and should get more traction.
